title: DELIVERY OF DISPENSER, TOWEL ROLLS AND SHARPS CONTAINERS
agency_path: City of New York > Chief Medical Examiner
description_text: Contracts awarded under this method may not exceed $1,500,000, inclusive of any and all change orders, overruns, amendments, renewals and extensions. The award will be made as a Blanket Order Delivery Purchase Order (PO) only for the item(s) indicated in this solicitation. The award was made to the bidder offering the lowest aggregate price for the delivery of Essential Items as indicated in this solicitation. All deliveries will be made as a result of a release order number or written request.
